HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__Description: The hatch pattern library: every pack the Patterns panel offers. Each pack is a folder holding its own HatchPack__Index__.json and its pattern files.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__PortedFrom: TrueVision3D 52__LayoutEditor__HatchPatternLibrary/HatchLibrary__Index__.json, Meta 1.1.0 (TrueVision3D v2.126.0, 21-Sep-2026; read at HEAD b2aa9151), ported 01-Oct-2026 (parity package W1-17). Every key, both packs and their order are TrueVision's: Construction Materials first, so Brickwork stays the pattern a vector's Hatch takes with nothing chosen, then the Site Plan pack, shipped because site plans port dormant (DR-08 (B), DR-19). The pack folders beside this file are TrueVision's, verbatim. Not copied: the two OS_Symbol__Examples reference sheets (nothing fetches them), and the empty folders Meta__EmptyPacks names, which git does not keep in either app.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__WhyAnIndex: Nothing lists a directory - not GitHub Pages, not the Flask dev server. A pack folder that is not listed here is invisible to the editor. A pack listed here with no index file does not break the panel - the loader skips it - but the browser still prints a red 404 for it in the console on every load, and no script can hide that. So an empty folder costs nothing only while it is NOT listed.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__HowToAddAPack: Make the folder, put a HatchPack__Index__.json in it listing its patterns, then add a row below - in that order. No code changes.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__PackOrder: The order below is the order the packs show in the Patterns panel and in every pattern list. It is also what 'the first pattern' means when a vector's Hatch is ticked with nothing chosen yet, so Construction Materials leads: a shape drawn on a building drawing is far more often a wall than a wood.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__EmptyPacks: On disk, empty, and deliberately not listed until each has a HatchPack__Index__.json: 01__GeometricHatches (Pack__Key GeometricHatches, label 'Geometric' - cross hatches, diagonals, stipples), and 03__Placeholder / 04__Placeholder (not yet named).

HatchLibrary__Packs.Pack__Note: Section hatches and elevation textures: masonry, concrete and fill, insulation, timber and metal.
